what_this_is: The Workshop row for reading one attachment of the Messages database on the person's Mac, run at that computer's local door (tools:run) over the home folder the person granted for reading. The reader is do-work/read-a-message-attachment.mjs, which answers the bytes of one attachment for the Messages screen to show inline.

payload.label: Read a message attachment on this Mac
payload.job: Answer the bytes of one attachment of the person's Messages database on this Mac, so a photo in a conversation can be shown inline
payload.description: Given attachment (the row id of the attachment in Messages' chat.db, as a whole number or a string of digits, or its guid), read that row, find the file its filename names under the person's Library/Messages/Attachments folder, and answer the file's bytes as base64 with its media type and length. chat.db is copied with its -wal into a private folder and the copy is read read-only, then the copy is removed. A file is read only when its path, symlinks resolved, is inside the attachments folder; a file over 700 KiB is refused with too_big so the answer stays under the 1 MiB JSON limit. With as jpeg, a picture is answered as a JPEG that macOS sips makes with its largest side at most_px (default 2048, 64 to 4096). No message text is read or returned. Needs Full Disk Access for the engine on this Mac (the messages source gate); without it the answer is refused with messages_not_readable. Returns said and either attachment with bytes_base64, or refused with its code.

attachment.description: The attachment's row id in chat.db (a whole number, or digits as text), or its guid

as.description: original answers the file as it is; jpeg answers a picture converted by macOS sips

most_px.description: With as jpeg: the largest side of the JPEG in pixels
